svg.title: From Probate Signal to Collected Commission
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-authority-to-retained-commission; chart type: process_flow; title: From Probate Signal to Collected Commission; subtitle: Five operating stages separate estate authority from brokerage execution.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Use the property's jurisdiction, current court orders, and actual appointment documents. California statutes illustrate routing rules, not uniform national procedure. Initial deal timing is 4–18 months.; caption: Docket alerts identify possible work; verified authority permits the appropriate next step. Recognized operator revenue is retained brokerage commission after brokerage splits, never property sale value.; stages: label: Detect and qualify; value: Create one deduplicated estate opportunity record; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use permitted court docket alerts and county property records to connect the estate, parcel, representative, and counsel. Record source dates; a filing alone does not establish sale intent.; label: Verify authority; value: Document who can authorize each transaction action; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Obtain appointment documents, current orders, and counsel's sale-path assessment. California Probate Code section 10501 requires different treatment for full and limited authority.; label: Engage and prepare; value: Execute brokerage scope and property preparation plan; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Confirm licensing, agency relationships, occupancy, insurance, access, and vendor budgets. Executor concierge work coordinates property tasks without replacing the representative or estate counsel.; label: Market and transact; value: Track offers alongside notices and court dependencies; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Use transaction checklists for disclosures, title exceptions, notice delivery, objections, and required confirmation. Avoid promising possession before occupancy and closing conditions resolve.; label: Close and reconcile; value: Match closing evidence to retained brokerage revenue; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Reconcile the closing statement, brokerage split, collection, and transaction expenses. Exclude escrow principal, estate proceeds, vendor reimbursements, and acquisition resale proceeds from this brokerage scorecard.

rect.title: label: Detect and qualify; value: Create one deduplicated estate opportunity record; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use permitted court docket alerts and county property records to connect the estate, parcel, representative, and counsel. Record source dates; a filing alone does not establish sale intent.

text.title: Use permitted court docket alerts and county property records to connect the estate, parcel, representative, and counsel. Record source dates; a filing alone does not establish sale intent.

rect.title: label: Verify authority; value: Document who can authorize each transaction action; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Obtain appointment documents, current orders, and counsel's sale-path assessment. California Probate Code section 10501 requires different treatment for full and limited authority.

text.title: Obtain appointment documents, current orders, and counsel's sale-path assessment. California Probate Code section 10501 requires different treatment for full and limited authority.

rect.title: label: Engage and prepare; value: Execute brokerage scope and property preparation plan; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Confirm licensing, agency relationships, occupancy, insurance, access, and vendor budgets. Executor concierge work coordinates property tasks without replacing the representative or estate counsel.

text.title: Confirm licensing, agency relationships, occupancy, insurance, access, and vendor budgets. Executor concierge work coordinates property tasks without replacing the representative or estate counsel.

rect.title: label: Market and transact; value: Track offers alongside notices and court dependencies; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Use transaction checklists for disclosures, title exceptions, notice delivery, objections, and required confirmation. Avoid promising possession before occupancy and closing conditions resolve.

text.title: Use transaction checklists for disclosures, title exceptions, notice delivery, objections, and required confirmation. Avoid promising possession before occupancy and closing conditions resolve.

rect.title: label: Close and reconcile; value: Match closing evidence to retained brokerage revenue; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Reconcile the closing statement, brokerage split, collection, and transaction expenses. Exclude escrow principal, estate proceeds, vendor reimbursements, and acquisition resale proceeds from this brokerage scorecard.

text.title: Reconcile the closing statement, brokerage split, collection, and transaction expenses. Exclude escrow principal, estate proceeds, vendor reimbursements, and acquisition resale proceeds from this brokerage scorecard.

Assumptions: Use the property's jurisdiction, current court orders, and actual appointment documents. California statutes illustrate routing rules, not uniform national procedure. Initial deal timing is 4–18 months.
